sources.name: thread
sources.prompt: One production PNG cutout of a small loose coil of warm ivory sewing thread lying completely flat on a horizontal turquoise worktable, seen from a gently elevated three-quarter viewpoint. Paint ONLY the ivory thread itself and an extremely subtle close-contact neutral blue-gray shadow immediately underneath its fine strands; table stays fully transparent. The flat thread forms three irregular overlapping flattened elliptical loops and one thin short loose tail resting flat. Absolutely no levitating curls, upright fabric, bow, spool, needles, cloth swatch or other objects. Fine matte cotton fiber texture, delicate soft brush-painted storybook quality with gentle upper-left sunlight; not a photograph, not a vector. Transparent alpha background with generous empty margin, no backdrop, colored glow, text, watermark, frame, borders or checkerboard. Ellipses are foreshortened with horizontal width about2.5times their total height, visibly lying flush in perspective. Simple modest real sewing material, not a decorative ribbon.
